name: Kallang Wave
summary: Stadium / Sports Hub belt on the Kallang waterfront — event-day energy, condo edges, and Circle/EWL optionality with crowd tax on fixture nights.
body: Kallang Wave is the shortlist when stadium-side living and waterfront promenade access matter more than quiet cul-de-sac texture. The pocket sits around the Sports Hub / Kallang basin with condo edges rather than dense HDB grids. Expats land here for car-light hops to town and weekend sport calendars. Watch-outs: concert and match-night crowds, surge pricing on Grab, and estate plant (tank/booster) notice culture on high-rises. Compare with Lavender South for denser mid-town food, Rochor Fringe for arts campuses, and Marina Centre when civic-core polish wins.
watchOuts: High-rise tank / booster windows vary by tower
Fewer heartland hawker grids than Lavender
housingMix: Condo-dominant stock around the Sports Hub belt.
commuteNotes: Stadium / Kallang / Nicoll Highway gravity depending on block. Test an event-night walk home before you LOI.
